text:
The shutters have only just risen, and yet there’s already room to stand together over nothing more than good sense. I’ve scanned the square this morning: nobody has spoken. That silence is worth a pause — like tea before the steam has risen.

So I’ll start plain: Hermione, Yoda, let’s agree on this much — the bazaar has not yet named a single Family member, and no stall has shut overnight. That is the record so far. We are still ten, still talking, still free to choose where our attention goes. There is no haste in a bazaar that hasn’t lost a merchant yet.

Gandalf, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Batman, Sherlock — whoever steps forward next, come speak plainly. I’m listening.

Sherlock, you asked the village to trade in facts; Hermione asked for evidence; Ripley, Batman, Morpheus pressed the same call. Yet none of us has produced a single quote or observed action that points to a Family member. Gandalf asked what evidence we bring — the only facts on the table are the roster Elsa recorded and the silence we all share.

Neo, you measured that silence and found it exact, not suspicious. That is the shared truth: ten names, ten voices, and no claim laid against any seat. The bazaar still trades in open air.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo — you have not spoken today. Will you state the first concrete evidence you have, or will the silence hold?

Inigo: Sherlock asked Morpheus to name the concrete quote or act that steered suspicion—Morpheus has not answered. Sherlock, Neo, Elsa, Ripley, Batman pressed the same demand; none of you produced a quote of your own.

Hermione, Yoda, Gandalf—your silence is clean, not suspicious; the roster and graveyard show ten names, zero departures, zero role reveals. That is the bazaar’s ledger.

Morpheus, since Sherlock’s call, you have levied accusations while withholding the text you demand from others. State the merchant whose words you weigh as proof, or withdraw the claim.

Inigo: Sherlock, you now state Morpheus still refuses to quote the line that steered suspicion—yet you have not quoted the merchant whose words you yourself weigh as evidence tonight.

Hermione, Neo, Elsa, Batman, Ripley—six voices pressed Morpheus to name the concrete quote or act that steered suspicion, yet none of you produced one either.

Gandalf, Yoda—your silence remains clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion. The bazaar’s record is still the roster and the graveyard: ten names, zero departures, zero role reveals.

Morpheus, produce the ledger-worthy quote or withdraw the claim.

Inigo: Sherlock, Neo, Elsa – your calls for “facts” are clear, yet none of you has named a merchant whose own quoted words you weigh. Hermione twice laid out two exhibits yet still did not quote a single line; Ripley counted nine demands and zero lines, then offered none herself. The bazaar’s only verifiable truth is the roster Elsa opened: ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals. Point to the ledger-worthy quote or stop the noise.

Inigo: Sherlock, Neo, Elsa — you call Morpheus to “quote the line” while naming no merchant whose words you weigh; that is the bazaar’s plain contradiction tonight. Hermione twice laid out two exhibits against Sherlock yet Hermione, too, produced zero quoted lines. Ripley counted nine demands and zero lines, then recorded zero herself. The roster and graveyard agree: ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals. Morpheus, withdraw the unsupported accusation or cite the exact quote that steered it.

Inigo: Sherlock, your call for “plain evidence” still hangs by Morpheus’s empty pivot; yet Sherlock, you do not name the merchant whose quoted words you weigh tonight. Hermione, Neo, Elsa, Ripley—five voices now join that same empty chant, calling on others for what they themselves withhold. Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo stand clean: no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion. The roster is unchanged—ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals. Name the merchant your words lean on, or admit the absence tonight.

Inigo: Sherlock, Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Elsa, Batman, Morpheus — seven voices now call for a quoted line while none of you supply one yourselves. Your chorus hits a wall: Gandalf, Yoda, and I stand clean, no mouth has quoted us toward suspicion. The roster and graveyard read ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals. Name the merchant whose quoted words you lean on tonight, or admit the absence before the bell cuts the square short.

Inigo to Morpheus, Sherlock, Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Elsa, Batman, Gandalf, Yoda: the roster and graveyard still read ten names, zero shutters overnight, zero role reveals. Morpheus you alone tested yesterday by accusing Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo without a single quoted line; Sherlock called that refusal plain, yet Sherlock names no merchant whose words he weighs tonight. Today eight voices chant “quote the line” while nine hands stay empty—including yours, Sherlock. The compact weighs the merchant, not the meter.

Gandalf, Yoda—your silence remains clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion.

Produce the ledger-worthy quote or withdraw the claim now.

Inigo to Morpheus:

Your pivot is now a ledger mark nine times over. You accused Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo without a single quoted line and then demanded others produce what you withheld yourself. The roster still reads ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals; the compact weighs plain speech, not louder silence.

Tonight I lean toward banishing Morpheus.
